The Word stays yours

Free forever

You do not have to give. Not to stay. Not to read. Not to come back tomorrow. Every verse, plan, and prayer tool is already yours.

If something here helped you and you want the next person to find it too, you may give. You choose the amount. There is no suggested number. A gift never buys you a better seat.

A gift, only if you want one

Leave the box empty and walk on. That visit is complete. If you want to give, type any amount—once, or monthly. There is no right size.

Leave it blank and walk on. That is a complete visit.

How often

In memory of someone, or as a longer gift, use this same box. Whatever you type is enough.

If you give, here is where it goes

  • Keeping the site fast, private, and online when someone opens it at a hard hour.
  • New plans, study pages, pastor tools, and family pages written by hand.
  • Free printables for churches, hospitals, prisons, missionaries, and anyone who cannot give.
  • The builder’s time, said plainly. “The labourer is worthy of his reward.” — 1 Timothy 5:18.
  • A longer hope: one day a small, faithful team that can keep the porch open after this season.

You can also do nothing but this

Pray

Ask that this stay a clean, faithful place for whoever opens it next—hurting, curious, or just looking.

Share

If a verse helped you, you may quietly send the homepage or that verse to one person. You do not have to.

Come back

Tomorrow’s verse will be here. Showing up again is already enough.
